scope: Diagnose all original endpoint rejections and evaluate a single fixed-rate latest-attempt request schedule on the same expanded development recording
request_bounds: First observed radar endpoint plus integer multiples of50ms, inclusive while <= last observed endpoint; no post-recording extrapolation
service_rule: Use latest raw endpoint at or before request. Reject if no prior endpoint, older than100ms, unready, or quality-withheld, in that fixed order. Never search backward for an older accepted value. No forward fill beyondTTL; no future radar or reference enters serving decision
implementation: Reuse checksum-protected previously computed frozen TCN mean and quality mask at actual endpoint; do not resample the model at an artificial current timestamp. No inference latency simulated
reference: Re-align existing publisher-verified reference at each actual request time, latest-prior status3 age<=100ms; missing truth explicit
assumptions: Bag timestamps stand in for availability time; model execution time, transport latency, clock authenticity and deployed TTL suitability unmeasured. Single grid phase andTTL; no sweep or best-case schedule selection. Regular scheduled-request fraction is not continuous uptime proof
